PR title:
Make option format replace newlines with spaces.

PR body:
#834 
Remade to point 7.x

Gold patch (use only to infer the symptom; do not quote or describe the fix):
diff --git a/CHANGES.rst b/CHANGES.rst
index c357a806..dcf97d04 100644
--- a/CHANGES.rst
+++ b/CHANGES.rst
@@ -38,6 +38,8 @@ Unreleased
     ``CliRunner.invoke``. :issue:`1435`
 -   Fix ``TypeError`` raised when using bool flags and specifying
     ``type=bool``. :issue:`1287`
+-   Newlines in option help text are replaced with spaces before
+    re-wrapping to avoid uneven line breaks. :issue:`834`
 
 
 Version 7.0
diff --git a/click/core.py b/click/core.py
index 01d77aa0..d4a29aef 100644
--- a/click/core.py
+++ b/click/core.py
@@ -943,7 +943,8 @@ class Command(BaseCommand):
         for param in self.get_params(ctx):
             rv = param.get_help_record(ctx)
             if rv is not None:
-                opts.append(rv)
+                part_a, part_b = rv
+                opts.append((part_a, part_b.replace('\n', ' ')))
 
         if opts:
             with formatter.section('Options'):

message.content: When an option's help text contains newlines, the help output displays uneven or broken line wrapping instead of properly formatting the text as a single continuous paragraph.
